notes: 弹力短袖：紧身弹力**罗纹针织**（整件竖条罗纹，每个颜色都要保住纹理）、平口（袖口下摆是无罗纹带的平折边）、领口罗纹
positive: RIB-KNIT FABRIC TEXTURE — HIGHEST-PRIORITY MATERIAL RULE, it must hold on EVERY colourway. This style is fine rib-knit jersey: the whole body and both sleeves show dense, fine vertical ribs (a 1x1 / 2x1 rib-knit look), evenly pitched, running down the garment and curving over the bust, the side seams and the sleeves. The ribs belong to the FABRIC, not to the colour: after the recolour they must still be clearly visible, in the same pitch, density, depth and direction as IMAGE 2 — on the master image AND on every derived colourway of this batch. The new colour is applied TO the ribbed knit, so the vertical rib lines stay readable in the new shade, including in shadow and in the highlights. Never flatten the ribs into smooth plain single-jersey, never render the new colour as a flat matte surface, never let the rib lines disappear or blur out, and never change the rib pitch. Hems stay PLAIN folded self-fabric (the hem is plain, the FABRIC is ribbed — do not turn the hems or the sleeve openings into rib-knit bands); the neckband is ribbed in the same pitch. CONVERT THE GARMENT TYPE (highest priority) — whatever garment the wearer has on in the source, the result must be exactly this garment: a stretch short-sleeve t-shirt (polyester-spandex jersey, fitted body, short sleeves, ribbed neckband). Rebuild it inside the scene instead of recolouring what is there: if the source shows a rib-knit cuff, a gathered or elastic cuff, a band that cinches the wrist or a ribbed waistband, remove all of that and finish the sleeves and the bottom hem as plain self-fabric folded hems of the sleeve's own width; the sleeve must run straight to that hem. The garment's fabric must match IMAGE 2 (fine rib-knit jersey (dense vertical ribs across the body and both sleeves, ribbed neckband, plain folded sleeve and body hems)) rather than the source, and none of these may appear on it: no hood, no drawstrings, no kangaroo pocket, no sweatshirt or fleece body, no rib-knit cuffs, no rib-knit hem, no elastic gathered cuff or hem, no long sleeves, no three-quarter sleeves. Only the printed artwork, the wearer, the scene and any text overlays are preserved. The sleeves must be genuine short sleeves ending above the elbow. GARMENT TYPE LOCK — the finished garment must be a stretch short-sleeve t-shirt (polyester-spandex jersey, fitted body, short sleeves, ribbed neckband). Keep it that exact garment type in every pixel: no hood, no drawstrings, no kangaroo pocket, no sweatshirt or fleece body, no rib-knit cuffs, no rib-knit hem, no elastic gathered cuff or hem, no long sleeves, no three-quarter sleeves. The printed artwork, its placement and the scene stay as instructed, but the garment itself must never drift into another style. SLEEVE LENGTH — GENUINE SHORT SLEEVES: each sleeve must end above the elbow, mid-upper-arm, with a clean hem, exactly like a short-sleeve T-shirt. If the source photo shows long sleeves or a sweatshirt, shorten them. Do not keep long sleeves, do not leave three-quarter or wrist-length sleeves, do not push or roll the sleeves up, and do not cover the forearm. CUFF & HEM CONSTRUCTION — the sleeve openings and the bottom hem are PLAIN, FLAT, self-fabric turned-and-stitched edges, exactly like a cotton jersey T-shirt: a single narrow hem folded under, and a straight flat hem line on the body. There is NO rib-knit band, NO elastic band, NO gathered or shirred cuff, NO elasticated waistband and NO contrast trim on the sleeve or hem. The sleeve keeps whatever width the reference photo shows (it may taper on a fitted style); there is no rib-knit BAND on the sleeve or the hem (the ribbed knit is the fabric itself, all over the garment). If the source photo shows a sweatshirt-style rib-knit cuff or ribbed hem, STRIP that ribbing: rebuild the sleeve end and the hem as plain self-fabric turned-and-stitched hems, with no ribs, no gathering and no elastic, and let the sleeve run straight to that hem instead of cinching in. Keep the cuffs and hem plain even where the hip or sleeve edge is in shadow or partly covered.
negative: Do not produce long sleeves, three-quarter sleeves, wrist-length sleeves or pushed-up sleeves; the sleeves must end above the elbow. Do not add ribbed cuffs, do not add a ribbed or elastic hem band, do not add gathered or elasticated sleeve openings, do not turn this T-shirt into a sweatshirt or hoodie, do not add sweatshirt fleece ribbing anywhere. Do not add hood, drawstrings, kangaroo pocket, sweatshirt or fleece body, rib-knit cuffs, rib-knit hem, elastic gathered cuff or hem, long sleeves, three-quarter sleeves. Do not flatten the rib-knit texture into smooth plain jersey, do not remove or blur the vertical rib lines on the body or the sleeves, do not change the rib pitch or density, do not paint the new colour as a flat matte surface without ribs, and do not lose the ribbed appearance on any derived colourway of the same style.

lessons.clause: Keep the neckline flat and close to the body; preserve the fitted silhouette without widening the body, shoulders, or sleeves.
lessons.negative: Do not widen the body or sleeves, and do not turn the flat neckline into a deep round neck.
lessons.zh: 领口再平一点，不要把版型改宽
lessons.reason: 领口形态和修身版型是该款通病，需要长期约束
